_comment: Seeded from Ark IDs.xlsx by tools/gen_tame_logic.py. AP tame/craft logic. item_recipes + dino_tame_raw + alias are the SOURCE. The apworld compiles dino_tame_raw into boolean AP rules (AND='+', OR='|'), expanding macros via item_recipes and mapping engram nodes via alias.
_comment_crafted_collects: Crafted 'Collect N <resource>' checks carry the resource's FULL craft chain here, not just its
engram (the code-side CRAFTED_COLLECT_ENGRAM rule only required the engram, so Collect 200
Narcotic needed Engram: Narcotic but no Mortar & Pestle and no foundation). Per Justin 2026-09-25:
Narcotic + Stimulant need the Mortar & Pestle (-> can_build), Gasoline needs a Metal Pick plus a
Refining Forge (-> can_build), Element Dust needs a high-tier fight tame (Strong | Insane) and no
longer requires the Fabricator engram. Cementing Paste keeps Lurch's 'Mortar & Pestle OR
Beelzebufo' - the frog makes paste without any station.
_comment_can_build: can_build = you have a foundation to put a crafting station on: Thatch OR Wood OR Stone.
ASE names a foundation *_Floor internally (PrimalItemStructure_StoneFloor = Stone
Foundation), so the alias entries below map the foundation nodes onto the Floor engrams.
Before 2026-09-24 those three nodes had no alias and an empty recipe, which compiles to
TRUE - so the foundation clause on the Forge and the Mortar & Pestle gated nothing and no
foundation ever had to appear in a playthrough. Reported by MiniDrachin from a spoiler log.
The bare Forge node carries can_build too: it is the same structure as Refining Forge, and
without it Gasoline / Metal Pick / Collect Metal Ingot would be a way around the gate.
NOTE: progression_tiers TIER_GATES is a separate mechanism and does NOT include a
foundation - a tier region still opens on the station engrams alone.

_comment_map_cave_reqs: Per-map artifact cave rules. cave_reqs is keyed by ARTIFACT, but the same artifact sits in a different cave on each map (Hunter: Island Lower South Cave, Ragnarok Jungle Dungeon). An artifact check is reachable if ANY enabled map that has it can reach its cave there; a map with no entry here uses cave_reqs. "" means that cave has no gate.
_comment_map_boss_artifacts: Per-map boss summoning artifacts, overriding boss_artifacts on that map. Ragnarok's Dragon and Manticore spawn together in one arena from the same ten artifacts.
_comment_map_boss_reqs: Extra requirement for a boss on that map, ANDed into that map's variant. '*' = every boss on the map.
_comment_alpha_kill_reqs: Per-alpha kill rule overriding the flat apex floor every alpha gets. Deliberately its own table: kill_reqs already holds Alpha Raptor/Rex/... entries that were never wired, and reading them would silently change the Island.
_comment_note_requires_tame: A note you only get by taming a creature (the Griffin dossier): gated exactly like that creature's Tamed: check, including the lock_taming unlock.
